Gmnotes: Wraiths begin at Far or Very Far edges and pressure anyone isolated from the protective ring. Wraiths slide in where attention thins or where fear isolates a PC. Psychological and predatory; wraiths seek fear, isolation, and priced memory.
Gmscript: Say: "This is the peak battle board. If they cluster, Group Attack. If someone hits last HP, Death Move. If the center holds, the outcome improves."
Gmreadaloud: Everything hits at once. The Custodian flickers at the center. The rusted dead try to turn one gap into a collapse.
Gmchecklist: Use Group Attack if skeletons cluster. Offer Death Move heroically at last HP. Let any PC create the final countdown tick. Set ritual_outcome from HOLD/BREAK.
Gmprivate: No single PC is required for the final blow; this map exists to spotlight shared sacrifice.
Playertakeaway: The wraiths drift closer. Their faces are the shape of remembered shame.
Storytakeaway: The peak makes the party choose what they save when they cannot cover everything.
Mechanictakeaway: HOLD/BREAK, Group Attack, Death Move, Hope, and countdown all write ritual_outcome.

The Custodian is exposed, the countdown is close, and choices become ritual_outcome. True Legacy Skeleton x4 — Tier 1 Standard. Difficulty 12. Thresholds 7/none. HP 2. Stress 1. ATK +0. Rusted Sword Melee 1d6+1 physical. Defeat rule: take 6 or less damage -> mark 1 HP; otherwise defeated. Group Attack: spend Fear, move several skeletons into Melee of one target, one shared +0 roll vs Evasion, 4 physical per skeleton combined. Each skeleton defeated ticks ritual_countdown -1; each Custodian hit/exposure ticks +1...
